name: Iizuki Mega
source:
An infamous delinquent and [url=/c60675]Nayuta's[/url] friend. He has a crush on [url=/c56948]Sugishira Yayamo[/url] and enjoys ship model building.

[Spoiler]He used to be part of an infamous Kantou-region banchou group called Megalomania (愛我郎魔睨悪) that earned respect through fighting.[/spoiler]
